name: Logistics & Supply Chain Management
focus: Supply chain strategy and design, sourcing and procurement, supplier relationships, inventory and distribution, transport and warehousing, risk and resilience, sustainability, the bullwhip effect, total landed cost, lean and agile supply chains.

name: Operations Management
focus: Process design, capacity and bottlenecks, quality management (TQM, Six Sigma), lean and just-in-time, planning and control, service operations, productivity, technology and automation in operations.

name: Strategic Planning
focus: Competitive advantage, industry analysis (five forces, PESTEL), resources and capabilities (VRIO), generic strategies, growth and diversification, mergers and alliances, business models, strategy implementation.

name: People, Work & Organisations
focus: Motivation and job design, organisational culture and structure, groups and teams, human resource management, employment relations, the psychological contract, organisational change, diversity, wellbeing, the future of work.

name: Leadership
focus: Leadership theories (trait, behavioural, situational, transformational, authentic), power and influence, ethics and responsibility, decision making, leading change, developing leaders, followership.

name: Economics for Business
focus: Demand, supply and elasticity, costs and market structures, pricing, competition and regulation, macroeconomic conditions (inflation, interest rates, growth), international trade, exchange rates, labour markets.

name: Financial Decision Making
focus: Financial statements and ratio analysis, working capital and cash flow, investment appraisal (NPV, IRR, payback), cost of capital, capital structure, budgeting, risk management, valuation.

name: Strategic Marketing
focus: Segmentation, targeting and positioning, brand equity, the marketing mix, pricing strategy, customer experience and loyalty, consumer behaviour, digital marketing, market research.

name: Delivering Successful Projects
focus: Project life cycle, scope, time and cost (the iron triangle), planning and scheduling, risk and stakeholder management, governance, agile and waterfall methods, benefits realisation, why projects fail.
